Learned trial judge, Muzaffar Nagar shall forthwith send a report regarding the status of the trial and cause for the delay in concluding the trial in Case Crime No. 144 of 2018 under Sections 420,
406, 506 IPC Police Station-Civil Lines District Muzaffar Nagar with the following details in tabulated form:-
(1) Number of prosecution witnesses proposed to be examined as per the charge sheet.

entities.text: Police Station-Civil Lines District Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: (2) Number of prosecution witnesses who have been examined before the trial court with dates.
(3) Number of witnesses who have been summoned but have not attended the trial proceedings on the appointed dates with dates.
(4) Number of witnesses against whom coercive measures have been taken out with dates.

District Legal Services Authority, Muzaffar Nagar shall submit a report with the following details:
A. The socioeconomic background of the applicant.
B. Whether the applicant is being informed about the status of his bail application on a regular basis by his pairokar/office of his counsel or any other sources ?

entities.text: District Legal Services Authority, Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: C. Whether the applicant is aware or apprised of his rights to get his bail application heard at an early date?
D. Whether the applicant has the resources to realise the aforesaid rights?

E. Steps taken by the District Legal Services Authority, to comply with the directions rendered by this Court in Anil Gaur @ Sonu @ Sonu Tomar Vs. State of U.P (Criminal Misc. The nature of cooperation required from the District authorities, Jail authorities and other administrative authorities, if any, in compliance of the directions issued by this Court in Anil Gaur (supra).
